title: Tracking URI detection: SageMaker MLflow is recognized by the mlflow-tracking-server ARN shape, not by partition, region, or account
answers: Why is my SageMaker endpoint ARN not treated as an MLflow tracking server?
How does MLflow detect that a tracking URI points to a SageMaker MLflow server?
Will a new AWS partition or region break SageMaker MLflow tracking URI detection?
Where is the SageMaker tracking URI check implemented?
body:
Path: Tracking URI shape checks in mlflow/utils/uri.py, used when choosing backend-specific behavior (for example client-side cost). is_sagemaker_mlflow_tracking_uri accepts only arn:<partition>:sagemaker:<region>:<account>:mlflow-tracking-server/<id>; SageMaker endpoint ARNs, sagemaker:/<region> strings, and http(s) URLs are not matched.
Rule: Detection splits the ARN into parts, then checks the 'arn' prefix, the 'sagemaker' service, the exact resource type 'mlflow-tracking-server', a '/' separator, and a nonempty resource id. It deliberately does not validate partition, region, or account, so new AWS partitions and regions are accepted without an allowlist update.
Symptom: n/a (convention for URI detection).
Constraints: An empty id after the slash (e.g. '.../mlflow-tracking-server/') is rejected. Similar-looking resource types such as 'mlflow-tracking-server-other' are rejected by the exact match.
applies: Detection of SageMaker MLflow tracking-server ARNs in tracking URIs; not for general ARN validation.
says: Connecting to a SageMaker tracking server in a newly launched AWS region fails
SageMaker model endpoint identifiers are not recognized as valid tracking server locations
Support custom AWS cloud partitions for SageMaker tracking server connection addresses
Tracking server connection fails when the resource identifier contains a trailing slash
Allow connecting to SageMaker tracking servers across any AWS account or partition

The detection checks the arn prefix, sagemaker service, exact mlflow-tracking-server resource type, slash separator, and a non-empty resource id, deliberately omitting partition, region, and account validation to support new regions and partitions. It rejects SageMaker endpoint ARNs, sagemaker:/<region> strings, http(s) URLs, trailing slashes with empty ids, and non-exact resource types like mlflow-tracking-server-other.
